content:
ryan (AE): Heads-up: MeridianTech asked for a CEO-level unblock tomorrow 10am PT. Stated priorities: sign pilot SOW, clarify pricing for dedicated nodes, and answers to the security questionnaire.
celeste (Head Sales): can we get a 20m bridge? Ask: a crisp exec one-pager + a clear redline path for the SOW.
micah (SE): for the one-pager i need to confirm: allowed egress destinations, KMS workflow (BYO vs managed), and baseline throughput numbers (requests/sec).
lina (Security): i'll take the security questionnaire. quick plan: i'll complete high-risk answers and flag anything needing legal or product exceptions.
jorge (Legal): note: any permanent data residency guarantees or addenda that mention physical possession trigger a legal review; we can accelerate with a short clause template.
ryan (AE): customer specifically asked whether we can sign an addendum guaranteeing that logs are stored only in their region during the pilot.
lina (Security): operationally feasible for pilot if they accept a limited retention window and BYO-KMS. i'll write the exact security response and include the risk statement.
revops-bot: auto: concessions >15% or extended SLA commitments must route to RevOps. Opened ticket #RV-2049.
micah (SE): network note: streaming preferred over TLS 443 websockets. if their perimeter blocks websockets we support 60s polling fallback. include this as a checkbox in the one-pager.
ryan (AE): calendar-bot can you create a shared brief and include a short SOW snippet + security answers?
calendar-bot: created brief at https://redwood.app/briefs/meridian-3487654321 and shared with participants.
celeste (Head Sales): action items: 
- micah: drop tech bullets + short SOW snippet (ETA 2h)
- lina: draft security questionnaire answers + region-locking clause (ETA 3h)
- jorge: prepare SOW redline template for execs (ETA 4h)
- ryan: assemble exec one-pager + pricing anchor (ETA 90m)

micah (SE): quick SOW snippet:
```
Pilot SOW (high level): 4-week pilot: remote private agent (1wk), on-prem deploy (2w), validation (1w). Baseline throughput target: 40 TPS. BYO-KMS supported; HSM integration 3-6w.
```

lina (Security): posted questionnaire answers into the doc and flagged Q12 (third-party subprocessors) for legal. Link: https://redwood.app/briefs/meridian-3487654321#security
jorge (Legal): i'll prepare a short addendum template for region-locking and subprocessor attestations. aim to share in 3h.
revops-bot: noted pricing anchor placeholder; any planned discount >15% must be approved (ticket #RV-2049).
ryan (AE): pricing anchor posted: recommend 14% off list with pilot credits. celeste — want to keep some negotiation room?
celeste (Head Sales): start at 14% and hold 4% flex for later. if they push SLA or permanent residency demands, escalate to me.
micah (SE): network check with customer netops: they can allow websockets only for specific FQDNs. i'll add the FQDN checklist to the doc.
ryan (AE): great. final for the bridge: i'll post the one-pager in 60m and include the escalation line: escalate unresolved legal/security blockers to celeste and jorge.
calendar-bot: invite sent to meridian-ceo@meridiantech.com and participants for 2026-06-10 10:00 PT.
celeste (Head Sales): thanks team 44d i'll be on the call and will hold the commercial guardrails. If Meridian demands an expanded SLA or deeper concessions during the call, escalate to me immediately.
